Title: Trial-Proven Dependency Overlay
Kind: Governance/dependency overlay for proving cycles (temporary DevBridge Phase 1/2 scaffolding; nothing migrates into Nexus)
Summary: After the governed closure of the WI-07-0.2.4 trial cycle (DB-M12.4, TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED / TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED / real status still Planned), the next proving candidate WI-07-0.2.5 is blocked by a textual dependency on WI-07-0.2.4 - a predecessor that is trial-proven but whose REAL roadmap status is and must remain Planned. DB-M03.2 adds a read-only TRIAL-PROVEN DEPENDENCY OVERLAY: for SUBSEQUENT PROVING-CYCLE SELECTION ONLY, a governedly closed TRIAL proving task may satisfy its dependencies - making WI-07-0.2.5 resolvable - WITHOUT modifying the real work-item status, the workbook, the roadmap, or the Nexus source baseline. A single shared qualification helper TrialDependencyOverlay.ps1 (Test-TrialDependencySatisfied, 6 gates + provenance builder) is dot-sourced by the four dependency-check sites: Get-NextTask.ps1 Test-DepsSatisfied, Test-DevelopmentPreflight.ps1 PART 4, Reserve-DevelopmentChange.ps1 Part 1 revalidation, New-ChatGptHandoff.ps1 PART 1 item 6. TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED is explicitly NOT COMPLETE/MERGED/REAL_VERIFIED_COMPLETE/M10_COMPLETE/READY_FOR_GOVERNED_COMPLETION; TRIAL_TO_REAL_COMPLETION_CAPABILITY = NO. M05 appends a truthful Trial-Proven Dependency Context section (real status authoritative, disposable proving context, real completion capability NO, restart point = preserved PRE-DEVBRIDGE baseline); M07 appends a Trial-Proven Dependency Distinction section. Invalidation produces honest blocks (TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE_INVALID / DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT_STALE / NO_TRIAL_HISTORY / EVIDENCE_DIR_MISSING / NOT_TRIAL_MODE / OVERLAY_DISABLED). Proof: 46-check matrix (A1-A7 unit, B8-B13 selection, C14-C22 preflight/M04/M05/M07, D23-D26 non-mutation, R27-R33 regressions, I34-I39 invariants + build) all PASS with exit 0; authoritative workbook SHA unchanged 6D42C3BF...E4F5; Nexus repo git state and live state/current-task.json asserted byte-identical (I35/I36); build 0 errors / 0 warnings. NO live M04 reserve, NO live M05 handoff, NO live M10, NO workbook mutation, NO Nexus source change, NO baseline restore.

RootCause.Observation: After the governed DB-M12.4 closure of the WI-07-0.2.4 trial cycle (real roadmap status still Planned), the next proving candidate WI-07-0.2.5 carries a textual dependency on WI-07-0.2.4; without an overlay the dependency gate requires a Completed/Complete predecessor, so selection would stall forever at NO_IMPLEMENTABLE_DESCENDANT - yet marking WI-07-0.2.4 Complete is forbidden (trial evidence must never become real Nexus completion).
RootCause.Classification: Dependency-qualification gap for CHAINED TRIAL PROVING (subsequent proving-cycle selection only)
RootCause.WhyGap: Test-DepsSatisfied had no way to honor a governedly closed TRIAL proving task as satisfying a dependency for the next proving cycle without writing false real completion.
RootCause.Correction: Read-only trial-proven dependency overlay: 6-gate qualification of preserved TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED evidence (mode TRIAL, closure history, DB-M18.1 freshness, evidence tree present, claude-decision PASS/VERIFICATION_PASS/TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED) -> TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED with truthful provenance (realStatus authoritative, realNexusCompletion false, disposableProvingContext true, TRIAL_TO_REAL_COMPLETION_CAPABILITY NO); wired into the 4 dependency-check sites; truthful trial-proven context in M05 handoff and M07 review package; honest block tokens on invalidation/staleness.

EngineSurface.OverlayGates: Test-TrialDependencySatisfied: (0) enabled (config trialDependencyOverlay.enabled != false; env DB_TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_OVERLAY not in 0/false/False/FALSE; default enabled) else OVERLAY_DISABLED; (1) Get-DevBridgeMode == TRIAL else NOT_TRIAL_MODE; (2) trial-proving-history entry {TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED, TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED, TRIAL, preReservationStatus Planned} else NO_TRIAL_HISTORY / TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE_INVALID; (3) DbM181Context.FreshnessStatus != DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT_STALE else DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT_STALE; (4) evidence dir <stateDir>/../logs/tasks/<node>/<change> exists else EVIDENCE_DIR_MISSING; (5) claude-decision.json dbM06Result==VERIFICATION_PASS AND decision==PASS AND trialMode==true AND implementationState==TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED else TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE_INVALID.
EngineSurface.Provenance: nodeId, changeId, closedAtUtc, result, mode, implementationState, preReservationStatus, realStatus, realStatusAuthoritative=true, overlayStatus=TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED, realNexusCompletion=false, disposableProvingContext=true, trialEvidenceUsed, sourceCycle, verificationEvidence{m06Result,testsPassed,testsFailed,testsSkipped,testsTotal,buildSucceeded,buildWarnings,buildErrors,harness}, claudeEvidence{milestone,decision,trialMode,implementationState,reviewedAgainstDbM06,reviewTimestampUtc}, closureEvidence{result,mode,implementationState,preReservationStatus,closedAtUtc}, repositoryReconciliation{historicalTrialEvidence,currentTrialRepositoryReality=EVIDENCE_PRESENT,freshness,staleReasons}.
EngineSurface.InsertionSites: 1) Get-NextTask.ps1 Test-DepsSatisfied: dep satisfied if live status Completed/Complete OR overlay qualifies; SelectionBasis truthfully records the overlay. 2) Test-DevelopmentPreflight.ps1 PART 4: trial-proven deps yield state TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED (real status preserved) + leafValidation PASS with overlay detail. 3) Reserve-DevelopmentChange.ps1 Part 1 revalidation: re-qualifies at reserve; stale/invalid -> honest block. 4) New-ChatGptHandoff.ps1 PART 1 item 6: live recheck honors TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED like SATISFIED; Trial-Proven Dependency Context section appended.
EngineSurface.TruthfulConsumption: M04 reserves only WI-07-0.2.5 (predecessor real status never altered). M05 handoff Trial-Proven Dependency Context: predecessor TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED / TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED, real roadmap status Planned + authoritative, overlay TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED, real completion capability NO, disposable proving context, restart point = preserved PRE-DEVBRIDGE baseline. M07 package Trial-Proven Dependency Distinction separates real Completed from trial-proven TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_SATISFIED.
EngineSurface.BlockTokens: TRIAL_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE_INVALID / DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT_STALE / NO_TRIAL_HISTORY / EVIDENCE_DIR_MISSING / NOT_TRIAL_MODE / OVERLAY_DISABLED (honest blocks; never fake satisfaction).
